originality.rationale: The directly motivating 2026 primary source gives an exact expected stopping-time formula for a specified code/layout (Theorem II.3) and MDS optimality only when an MDS code exists (Theorem II.6), explicitly leaving non-MDS small-field optimization open in Section V. Binary [6,3] is non-MDS and the new 125/56 global optimum plus unique Fano-line extremal geometry require an additional exhaustive minimization. The inspected 2025 and 2023 primary works treat one container. The published rank-two result has a different dimension and does not imply the binary rank-three optimum. Targeted source, value, geometry, equivalence and comparison searches disclosed no covering result. Possible unindexed or implicit coverage remains a risk.

value.rationale: The motivating 2026 distributed DNA storage study explicitly leaves balanced and non-MDS small-field optimization open. The binary [6,3] 3+3 instance is the first balanced rank-three binary non-MDS two-container case, and the finding gives not just a numerical value but all Fano-geometric optimizers, their entire recovery-time law, and the sharp 3/28-round loss against the hypothetical MDS benchmark. This is a natural exact constrained-code invariant rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
